name: Car Thing bridge
description: Lets a Spotify Car Thing running the bootleg-bridge-thing app, or a bootleg-pod handheld on Wi-Fi, control playback and show what is playing. Connects to the bridgething desktop app on this computer and/or to the handheld.

settings.label: Bridge addresses
settings.hint: Where the bridgething desktop app listens (ws://127.0.0.1:8899/bootleg). Add a handheld by its address from its Remote page (ws://<ip>:8899/bootleg?key=…), separated by a comma.
